sampling.method: 24 unique uint32 seeds drawn once with OS cryptographic RNG before any game or outcome
sampling.inferenceScope: Synthetic independent layouts from engine.initial(seeded(seed)); not human-play superiority or all chess variants.

adoption.method: paired-layout bounded Hoeffding, two one-sided 97.5% bounds

resourceNotes.all: 2000 ms per move, at most 4 search threads, 64 MiB TT budget. Persistent readiness outside clock; observation, sampling, protocol, search, stop/reap inside clock.
resourceNotes.mist: Both arms are current production HCE search with the same bounded map arena; candidate replaces only static evaluation with the pinned JQE network, including typed pool keys. 8 worlds when dark, 1 when fully revealed. Same 40 ms host and current core reserves. Candidate has neural accumulators and larger typed pool keys; total RSS and effective TT entry capacity are not equal.
resourceNotes.rules: Current engine.js: mate/stalemate first; three full checking cycles lose for responsible checker, not last mover. Other repetitions need ruling, never automatic draw. 120 quiet absent ruling is draw; 400 cap unresolved. Current safeRoots forbids proven long-check losses when alternatives exist.
